offerWriter.title: Offer writer
offerWriter.summary: Writes an offer from your price list and cites every price.
offerWriter.needsPriceList: Needs the folder with your price list.
offerWriter.try1: Write an offer for Müller GmbH for 10 licenses.
offerWriter.try2: Which prices in the list apply to a one-year support contract?

hrHandbook.title: HR handbook
hrHandbook.summary: Answers questions about the written handbook and cites the passage. It does not make hiring decisions.
hrHandbook.needsHandbook: Needs the folder with your handbook.
hrHandbook.try1: How many days of leave does the handbook allow?
hrHandbook.try2: What does the handbook say about working from home?

tenderResponse.title: Tender response
tenderResponse.summary: Drafts answers to tender questions and cites the source file.
tenderResponse.needsFolder: Needs the folder with your tender documents.
tenderResponse.try1: Answer the question about our support hours, and cite the file.
tenderResponse.try2: Which documents do we still need for this tender?

contractSummary.title: Contract summary
contractSummary.summary: Summarises a contract in plain language. This is not legal advice.
contractSummary.try1: Summarise the parties, the term and the payment.
contractSummary.try2: What happens if we end the contract early?

meetingMinutes.title: Meeting minutes
meetingMinutes.summary: Turns notes or a transcript into decisions and action items.
meetingMinutes.try1: Turn these notes into minutes with decisions and action items.
meetingMinutes.try2: List only the actions, with the owner when one was named.

socialPosts.title: Social posts
socialPosts.summary: Drafts three posts from a press release, without adding facts.
socialPosts.try1: Write three posts from this press release.
socialPosts.try2: Make a shorter version of the second post.

itHelpdesk.title: IT helpdesk
itHelpdesk.summary: Writes a first answer from your help articles and cites the article. It does not open a ticket.
itHelpdesk.needsArticles: Needs the folder with your help articles.
itHelpdesk.try1: A colleague cannot connect to the VPN. What should they try first?
itHelpdesk.try2: How do we reset a forgotten password?

dailyBriefing.title: Daily briefing
dailyBriefing.summary: Prepares a weekday morning briefing from your mailbox after you connect it and publish the assistant.
dailyBriefing.needsMail: Connect your mailbox so the briefing can read it.
dailyBriefing.try1: What in my mailbox needs a decision today?
dailyBriefing.try2: Skip newsletters and list only the messages I should answer.
